Container.Name: immich-sync
Container.Overview: Immich Multi-Sync Hub: One-way sync from Immich (master) to Amazon Photos and iCloud Photos with Web UI and continuous background daemon. Place a .env file in /mnt/user/appdata/immich-sync/.env to configure all credentials and settings automatically.

Config.Name: Browser View Port (noVNC)
Config.Description: Web VNC viewer port for interactive Amazon Photos Playwright sign-in

Config.Name: AppData Directory
Config.Description: Persistent folder for .env (auto-loaded), config.json, sync_state.db, .icloud_session, and temp staging

Config.Name: Auto-Start Sync Daemon
Config.Description: Automatically start the continuous background sync daemon when the container boots (true/false)

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Internal path inside container for persistent files

Config.Name: Dashboard Username
Config.Description: Username for Web UI HTTP Basic Auth (used when Dashboard Password is set)

Config.Name: Dashboard Password
Config.Description: Optional password to protect the Web UI with HTTP Basic Auth (recommended on Unraid LAN)
